chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Blessed, is not a tyrant to His servants.
ai.seo_question: What does the Imam say about God's justice towards His servants?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this creedal statement as a foundational pillar of Shia theology, emphasizing *Adl* (Divine Justice) as an attribute of God’s essence rather than merely an action. This assertion refutes the Qadariyyah and Mu'tazilah extremes, affirming that while God is the ultimate source of all good, He does not compel evil nor wrong His creation, thereby preserving human free will within divine decree.
